headline: 4 dead, 1 missing after fishing trawler capsizes off Kutubdia coast
summary: The accident occurred in the Bay of Bengal during rough seas and high waves, leaving seven other fishermen rescued.
details: Four fishermen were killed and one remains missing after a fishing trawler capsized in rough seas off the coast of Kutubdia in Cox's Bazar.
The deceased were identified as Mohammad Sagar, Mohammad Karim, Mohammad Ayub Monir from Boroghop union, and Kamal Hossain from Ali Akbar Deil union.
The missing fisherman, Nasir Uddin, is a resident of Magnama Union in Pekua upazila. Seven other crew members were rescued by a passing fishing trawler.
The vessel, FB Fakira Mosjid, left Amjakhali Ghat on Sunday morning with 12 fishermen onboard for deep-sea fishing.
The accident happened around 4:00 am on Monday morning when powerful waves suddenly capsized the trawler in the Bay of Bengal.
The sunken trawler was recovered on Monday evening, and the bodies of the four fishermen were found inside the cabin where they had been sleeping.
Police and the fishermen's association are continuing efforts to locate Nasir Uddin, while legal procedures are underway.

headline: Bandarban devastated by floods: hundreds of thousands left homeless
summary: Severe flooding in Bandarban has forced countless residents to seek shelter under the open sky, creating a humanitarian crisis.
details: Severe flooding has devastated Bandarban, leaving hundreds of thousands of people displaced from their homes.
Many residents are now forced to live under the open sky, having lost their houses and belongings to the rising waters.
The scale of the disaster has created an urgent need for food, clean water, and temporary shelter for the affected populations.
Local authorities and rescue teams are working to manage the crisis, but the extent of the damage to infrastructure and homes is immense.
